Name: Paper Stardew (Stardew Symphony Pack)
Author: TheProfessorYoshi
Description:
Paper Mario music, now in Stardew Valley! Contains tracks from Paper Mario, Paper Mario: The Thousand Year Door, and Super Paper Mario. There are 48 tracks in total; 15 from Thousand Year Door, 16 from Super Paper Mario, and 17 from Paper Mario. I've included a short text document with suggestions for how to assign the tracks. This is a [b]Content Patcher[/b] file; it won't work without it. It also requires [b]Stardew Symphony[/b] to have any effect. To install this mod, just unzip it and place the file into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley folder! 

This is my first mod, so any and all feedback is appreciated. Thanks!
